channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
item.description: The Gemini Decisions API evaluates 1,000 yes/no questions in a single pass across text, images, video and PDFs, with 150–250 ms latency and $0.1 per million input tokens, detailing Google's new Gemini Decision 1 model. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: Gilbert + Tobin uses ChatGPT Enterprise to build multi-step workflows that reach 87% active usage under human review, freeing lawyers for more human-centered work at the Australian corporate law firm. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Issue types and fields are available for personal accounts
item.description: GitHub issue types and issue fields are now generally available on repositories owned by personal accounts, letting individual developers and open source maintainers standardize workflows, organize issues across repositories, and create labels or milestones directly in issues. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
item.description: AlphaGenome 2 predicts how DNA variants affect hundreds of human cell types, drawing on 68 tissues and a single-cell atlas of over 100 million cells to identify nearly twice as many expression-altering variants as its predecessor. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
item.description: Google Labs' Tabletop experiment lets users prompt @tabletop or pick templates to generate itineraries, dinner polls, bill splits and tournament brackets, then share an invite link for Google Docs-style real-time group collaboration, with US 18+ users currently on a waitlist. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: AI Office Race Shifts From Model Capability to Cost and Choice: Doubao Work Opens to Third-Party Models
item.description: Doubao Work’s November 12 update adds third-party models Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, with quota-consumption multipliers and limited-time discounts letting users pick by task and cost. (AIbase)

item.title: Claude interactive connectors upgraded: apps can open full-screen alongside the conversation and support direct interaction
item.description: Anthropic's Claude interactive connector upgrade lets tools open full-screen beside the conversation while Claude directly edits pages, table rows or files, with changes shown in real time for confirmation, rolling out to web and desktop across all plans. (AIbase)

item.title: Experience the art and legacy of Dr. Esther Mahlangu
item.description: Google Arts & Culture has launched the first online retrospective of Dr. Esther Mahlangu for her 91st birthday, gathering more than 45 stories and archives and using AI to recreate her missing pre-1980 childhood memories of Ndebele art. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Free photo gallery becomes a traffic funnel? Win11 Photos app quietly hooks into Adobe
item.description: Microsoft and Adobe have finalized a partnership that, starting next month, will invite Windows Insider Program members to preview a Photos app with Adobe's editing engine embedded in the free image viewer. (AIbase)

item.title: China's Diting seismic model debuts with a 20-million-item dataset, letting AI hear the Earth's "heartbeat
item.description: China’s Diting earthquake model aggregates over 20 million high-quality data records and can rapidly provide seismic information from a single station for major-earthquake reporting, while its team plans to mine deep signals for prediction research. (AIbase)

item.title: Volcano Engine launches Seedance 2.5 Flash: twice the generation speed, about ¥0.99/second at 720P, 34% cheaper than the flagship
item.description: Volcano Engine's November 12 launch of Seedance 2.5 Flash doubles video generation speed, prices 720P output at about 0.99 yuan per second—34% below the flagship—and supports clips up to 30 seconds. (AIbase)

item.title: 百度发布大模型交易平台“词元所”：宣称中立可信，打造大模型界的“证券交易所”
item.description: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li launched Token Exchange, a large model service platform applying stock-exchange principles such as strict admission and continuous monitoring to address enterprise developers' difficulty choosing models and lack of trust. (AIbase)

item.title: ScroogeFrog AI — AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
item.description: ScroogeFrog AI's page promising AI ad fraud detection to protect marketing budgets currently displays only a CAPTCHA security check, offering no features, data or case studies. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Baidu's ERNIE Gets Another Upgrade: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview Debuts, Model Weights to Be Open-Sourced by November 25
item.description: Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview pairs 280B total parameters with 14B activated and a 1M-token context window, is already live on the Qianfan API, and its weights are promised open-source by November 25. (AIbase)

item.title: United Airlines Bans AI Agents From Booking Flights On Behalf of Travelers
item.description: United Airlines Bans AI Agents From Booking Flights On Behalf of Travelers (Slashdot)

item.title: Mitra MCP — Give your AI agents access to your personal phone line
item.description: Despite a title promising that Mitra MCP gives AI agents access to a personal phone line, the page itself serves only a website security check and CAPTCHA, with no readable detail on how the integration works. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Tencent denies 50% layoff rumors, says it plans to devote half its workforce to AI Native exploration
item.description: On November 12, Tencent public relations director Zhang Jun denied rumors of 50% layoffs, saying roughly half its workforce stays on core business while about half explores AI Native as AI-era resource reallocation. (AIbase)

item.title: Google's software engineering team (SWE) deployed 48 AI agents to analyze NASA lidar data, discovering an unmapped Maya pyramid within 72 hours
item.description: Google's software engineering team (SWE) deployed 48 AI agents to analyze NASA lidar data, discovering an unmapped Maya pyramid within 72 hours (pietromiotti.com)

item.title: openai/codex-security — OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
item.description: @openai/codex-security ships as a CLI and TypeScript SDK that scans repositories inside Codex sessions, saves findings as Markdown reports, and requests patches, requiring Node.js 22.13.0+ or 24/26.x plus Python 3.10+. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: AI, Activities, and Outcomes in Software Engineering
item.description: Christian Bird's 21-minute UC Irvine software engineering seminar talk on October 30, 2026 draws on 30 interviews and related research to examine AI, activity and outcomes, asking why AI has not solved software engineering. (cabird.com)
